description: Select an Area of Interest by search, click, drawing, or upload.

descriptionFull.title: Pick an Area of Interest (AOI) on the map. Choose a state, county, or city from a preset list, click an administrative boundary, draw a shape, or upload a GeoJSON / KML. When a layer with timeseries analysis is active, an Analyze area action becomes available; the analysis itself is rendered by a separate Analysis plugin via the mmgisAPI event bus.

name: AOI

components.name: Separated Tool
components.description: If true, this tool lives outside the left-hand toolbar and floats over the map (matches the Figma design).

components.name: Justification
components.description: Where the floating panel anchors. 'right' matches the Figma; 'left' or unset places it center / left.

components.name: Draw Shapes
components.description: Which shapes appear in the Draw tab. Comma-separated subset of: point, linestring, polygon, rectangle, circle. If empty, defaults to polygon, rectangle, circle.

components.name: States GeoJSON
components.description: Mission-relative path to a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of state polygons. If empty, the plugin falls back to the bundled defaults under Tools/AOI/assets.

components.name: Counties GeoJSON
components.description: Mission-relative path to a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of county polygons.

components.name: Cities GeoJSON
components.description: Mission-relative path to a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of city points or polygons.
